items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: The interviewee (Chris Yassich) does not mention Andrew. The interviewer mentions 'Andrew's sister's record' in relation to Paul Tugas and Chris Yassich, but the interviewee only confirms details about Chris and Sig Christian, showing no personal connection to Andrew.

ctx.x: Chris Yassich. No, no, no. Chris used to want to write the parodies on the tunes for Paul Tugas.

I remember him saying that with Pinky when he would write a thing, don't worry if it's not going to be a hit. Because he says if it gets on the record and if the flip side is a hit, he says you got a hit too. So, I mean, he wrote a lot of things that he just wanted to get on record. And he had one of them on the one side of Andrew's sister's record that he did very well. I can't remember his name. He used to, he was a publisher from, he used to have a publishing company.

Yeah, I remember the one that was running out was Chris, not Chris. No, Sig Christian's his old lady. That's the one you're talking about. I can't remember his name. I can't remember his name. I can't remember his name.
